keyMessages: Mostly clear skies and near normal temperatures (highs in the 60s and low-70s) are expected Friday.
A weekend disturbance will bring widespread rain (90-100% chance) and well below normal temps (highs in the upper-40s and 50s).
Near to below normal temperatures (highs 50s and 60s) are expected next week through Wednesday.
